task_name: Promoter Activity Prediction Model Construction using lentiMPRA Data for cis-regulatory elements of human HepG2 cells, the sequence is 200bp, which represents a core cis-regulatory element (cCRE) centered at a DNase I hypersensitivity site peak midpoint (±100 bp)
task_goal: Construct a deep learning model to predict the relative regulatory activity ('fitness' column) of human HepG2 cell cis-regulatory element sequences based on their sequence features derived from the lentiMPRA dataset (MPRALegNet).
task_requirements: The model should be a deep learning model, and the model should be able to predict the relative regulatory activity of the 200bp cis-regulatory element sequences.The parameters of the model should be no more than 3M. The evaluation metrics are PCC(Pearson Correlation Coefficient), SCC(Spearman Correlation Coefficient) and MAE(Mean Absolute Error).

task_dataset.data_type: lentiMPRA Data of human HepG2 cell cis-regulatory elements (cCREs), the sequence is 200bp, representing a core regulatory region centered at DNase I hypersensitivity site peaks, with regulatory activity measured as log2(RNA/DNA) ratio normalized fitness scores
task_dataset.key_constraint: The sequence data is in the 'sequences' column, the length of the input sequence is all 200bp and the target variable is in the 'fitness' column.
